prompts.prompt: Wide photojournalism shot from the upper deck of a sold-out Las Vegas arena during a UFC-style octagon card, the cage lit white in the center, thousands of fans with phone lights, broadcast camera rig in the foreground, red and gold accent lighting against deep black, energy of a record-gate night

Editorial business photograph on a black glass boardroom table: a printed quarterly earnings report with a rising red bar chart, a pair of black 4-ounce MMA fight gloves resting beside it, a fountain pen and a calculator, a city skyline at dusk through the window behind, warm gold desk light, Reuters-style corporate photography, money and fighting in one frame

Documentary stadium photograph: a huge enclosed rugby stadium with its roof closed, set up for a heavyweight boxing night, the ring in the center of the pitch under a white lighting truss, 70,000 seats rising on all sides, streaming broadcast cameras on cranes, red and gold lighting washing the stands, scale of a global streaming event

Courtroom photojournalism inside a modern U.S. federal courtroom: counsel table stacked with legal binders and exhibit tabs, an open laptop, a banker's box of documents with a pair of worn MMA gloves on top, the empty judge's bench in soft focus behind, cool daylight with one red accent, serious antitrust-case atmosphere

Live fight photography from cage-side at a packed New York arena: two heavyweight mixed martial artists mid-exchange inside the octagon, shot through the fence with motion blur on gloves and bodies, sweat spray under harsh overhead lights, faces turned away or hidden by gloves and motion, crowd blurred in red and gold tones, the feel of fight week

Ringside press row at a big boxing night: reporters' laptops, spiral notebooks with handwritten round-by-round notes, a stack of printed press releases and a phone recording, the ring apron and ropes in soft focus behind, red and gold arena light on a black table, working-journalist photojournalism
